origins.section: The Class You Extend Decides Who Must Handle It
A Wrapper Keeps the Original Failure Only If It Is Given the Cause
Every Exception Is Serializable, So Its Fields Must Be Too
An Exception Class Can't Be Generic
Filling In the Stack Trace Is Most of the Cost; Skip It Only Where Nobody Reads the Trace

recorded.prompt:q-plugin-throwable: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-plugin-throwable: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-plugin-throwable: Correct option c is decided by the Throwable example. Job declares 'void run() throws Throwable', the runner catches 'catch (Exception e)', and the output for 'extends Throwable' shows 'job 0 done' and then 'runner ended by QuotaExceeded', with no 'job 1 failed' line. The text says: 'QuotaExceeded is not an Exception, so the safety net, usually written as catch (Exception e), never sees it, and job 2 never runs.' 'Sits beside Exception rather than under it' is a fair restatement of 'is not an Exception'.
recorded.prompt:q-import-cause-only: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-import-cause-only: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-import-cause-only: Correct option a is decided. The third output block is 'SettlementException: java.sql.SQLException: deadlock detected' for 'new SettlementException(e)'. The text says 'The (cause) constructor keeps the chain but takes cause.toString() as its message', and the Reference table gives getMessage() = 'cause.toString()' for (Throwable cause). The reader has to carry this over from SQLException to IOException, which is a direct analogy.
recorded.prompt:q-transient-price-list: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-transient-price-list: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-transient-price-list: Correct option a is decided by: 'Marking the field transient silences the error, but a transient field isn't written and reading doesn't run the constructor, so it arrives as null.' The NullPointerException from priceList.sku() is a one-step Java inference that the page does not show, which is acceptable.
recorded.prompt:q-pipeline-stage: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-pipeline-stage: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-pipeline-stage: Correct option a is decided by: 'The rule also covers an inner (non-static) class declared inside a generic class, which is implicitly generic too; a static nested class compiles.' The Reference table says 'an inner class extending Exception inside class Batch<T> | the same error; a static nested class compiles'. The question uses RuntimeException, and the page's main example ('class RejectedException<T> extends RuntimeException') shows that the rule covers any Throwable subclass ('a generic class may not extend java.lang.Throwable').
recorded.prompt:q-cheap-not-found: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-cheap-not-found: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-cheap-not-found: Correct option a is decided. 'With writableStackTrace = false no trace is captured.' The page shows 'The whole output of printStackTrace() for the cheap one: CheapNoMatchException: no rule matched', and the Reference gives getStackTrace() 'empty'. Small gap: the stem logs through log.error("lookup failed", e), and the page only shows printStackTrace(), never a logging framework's output. The reader has to assume the logger prints the same thing.

recorded.prompt:q-plugin-throwable:a: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-plugin-throwable:a: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-plugin-throwable:a: Refuted by the same example. Job declares 'throws Throwable', yet catch (Exception e) does not handle QuotaExceeded ('never sees it'). The page shows this but never states the general rule ('a catch clause handles only its own type and subtypes'). The says text is an accurate generalisation of what the page shows.
recorded.prompt:q-plugin-throwable:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-plugin-throwable:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-plugin-throwable:b: Refuted by: 'A direct subclass of Throwable is also checked, so every interface it passes through must declare it, as Job does here.' 'Not a RuntimeException' follows from 'class QuotaExceeded extends Throwable'.
recorded.prompt:q-plugin-throwable:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-plugin-throwable:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-plugin-throwable:d: The first half ('logs nothing and leaves the loop') is true. The reason is refuted: 'main catches whatever leaves runAll and prints "runner ended by"', and the output shows that line, so the thread is not stopped and a caller further up catches it. This supports the says text.
recorded.prompt:q-import-cause-only:b: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-import-cause-only:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-import-cause-only:b: Refuted by 'takes cause.toString() as its message' and by the output, which includes the cause's fully qualified class name ('java.sql.SQLException: deadlock detected'), not just its message.
recorded.prompt:q-import-cause-only:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-import-cause-only:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-import-cause-only:c: Refuted by the Reference table: (Throwable cause) gives getMessage() 'cause.toString(), or null when cause is null'. Only the () row has getMessage() null outright. The says text 'only the () constructor, or a null cause, leaves the message null' overstates a little: by the table's '(String message) -> message' row, passing a null message also leaves it null.
recorded.prompt:q-import-cause-only:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-import-cause-only:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-import-cause-only:d: Refuted by the same cause.toString() passage and table. The second clause of the says text, 'when a message is null, toString() prints only the class name', is NOT supported by the page. The page only says 'toString() ... prints the class name and the message' and never shows the null case.

recorded.pass:q-pipeline-stage:b: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-pipeline-stage:b: Refuted by inference rather than stated directly. The page gives the reason for the error as genericity ('a generic class may not extend java.lang.Throwable') and says 'a static nested class compiles'. Every exception on the page calls super(message). The page never addresses super() in nested classes, but a reader can rule b out because the stated cause is different and the static variant compiles.

recorded.prompt:q-cheap-not-found:c: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-cheap-not-found:c: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-cheap-not-found:c: Refuted by the printStackTrace output, which is one line with no 'at' frames, and by the Reference 'getStackTrace() | empty'. The page doesn't say in words that 'printing doesn't walk the stack', but the output shows it.
recorded.prompt:q-cheap-not-found:d: the page and the question, and nothing else
recorded.pass:q-cheap-not-found:d: independent readers: a page-free reader (wording only) and a page reader with the page and the quiz, each a fresh agent
recorded.outcome:q-cheap-not-found:d: Refuted by 'With writableStackTrace = false no trace is captured' and the output with no frames. Partly true: the Reference shows that later changes are blocked too ('setStackTrace(t) | ignored', 'addSuppressed(s) | ignored'), so only the word 'only' makes d wrong. That is intended, but a reader might find it close.
